messages.subject: Global Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear J. Scrase,

Geosearch Consulting's mining and natural-resources search work makes this a strong fit for my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across mining and resources where responsible growth depends on regulatory credibility, social performance and stakeholder alignment. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
